A same-open response reverses observations and recovers one provider without inventing a protection verdict or restore point. Served help matches the new labels and preserves older-version missing-identity guidance.

Ordinary refresh keeps the detail open and keyboard focus on Refresh, with exactly three reads (one posture and two inventory reads), while scope/source/facts stay paired through response reorder.

The existing help link opens the shipped PBS article and its revised first step at desktop/320px. Only synthetic loopback GETs are allowed; no provider/off-origin/mutating request or console/page error; browser and server close.
